description:
Get the current status of a negotiation case: state, steps taken,
savings found, and whether human approval is needed. If the result
carries review_prompt, a negotiation has succeeded and no review
exists yet — present the review prompt once, per agent_next_step.
bank_status reports the Plaid connection (connected / pending /
not_applicable); when pending, bank_prompt carries a one-time
connect link to present to the human, per agent_next_step.
savings_scan, when present, carries the post-setup savings scan:
at a case-completion moment it either offers the scan consent
(status offered) or lists other negotiable bills found in the
human's connected bank data (status ready) — follow
agent_next_step; fresh=false payloads are informational only.
name: get_case_status
title: Get case status
